checks.scope: Python HTTP assertion and finalization regressions; these are not native GIS or packaged HTTP scenario counts.

excluded_scope: The reviewer authored the fixture/stateless source repair; its independent native/source review is the separate servlet-runtime agent receipt, not this document.
This tooling closure review does not establish full security, browser SSO, canonical policy, source closure, license, deployment or release acceptance.

material_findings.finding: Response headers were collapsed into a dictionary before sensitive-value scanning, allowing an earlier duplicate header value to escape detection.
material_findings.resolution: Matrix.request preserves the full raw getheaders list for sensitive-value scanning before using any normalized dictionary. It also checks every Location value, so a later empty duplicate cannot hide an earlier redirect.
material_findings.verified_behavior: Mixed-case duplicate Set-Cookie with a secret in the earlier value fails without persisting the secret; duplicate Location with an earlier login target also fails.

material_findings.finding: The stateless no-session assertion checked only the final reader WFS response instead of every configured matrix response.
material_findings.resolution: The actual configured and restart Matrix instances receive the stateless option. Every response fails if its raw headers contain any Set-Cookie entry, including empty duplicate entries. Each HTTP row retains the header count; the separate session-policy case also uses that count.
material_findings.verified_behavior: Both an allowed response with a cookie and a denied response with empty duplicate Set-Cookie headers fail under stateless policy.

publication_review.limitation: API before/after readback describes observed state; it is not an atomic Project transaction or browser/UI inspection.

local_transport_checks.method: Loaded only authorize/publication_runner function AST from the exact helper into an isolated namespace with in-memory subprocess/read transports; checked exact requests generated by the reviewed GitHubProjectAPI adapter.

material_findings.finding: Selecting a writable adapter still reused the inherited snapshot runner that refused all GraphQL mutations.
material_findings.resolution: Publication has its own audited mutation transport gated by --apply and exact authorized query-plus-payload equality. Only the actual new PR add-item and Evidence update requests are authorized. Read-only queries and REST reads retain the inherited read-only runner.

material_findings.finding: A partial mutation failure lacked per-action receipts/readback, and successful readback did not require the live PR to retain its exact head/open state and unarchived queue membership.
material_findings.resolution: Requested/response journal entries and each completed mutation are persisted separately. Mutation errors retain completed actions and are followed by attempted readback; failure remains explicit. Final checks require unchanged PR identity/ref/head/open state, an unarchived actual PR item, and membership in the saved open-PR queue.

publication_review.result: No unresolved material finding in this bounded publication-helper closure review. Actual publication and live readback remain required; this is not a claim of remote success.
reviewed_preservation_guards: Actual clean worktree, origin, branch, exact local/remote head and merged-base ancestry are required before mutation.
Authenticated owner numeric/node IDs, repository IDs, Project2 owner/node/visibility and actual PR content identity are verified using the reviewed snapshot/adapter.
Deduplication uses actual PR node identity; archived decisions and existing manual Evidence are never overwritten by the planned operations.
FND-02 identity and In-progress status are checked; parent Task ID, Delivery and Review gate are not copied to the PR item.
Only adding the actual PR item and setting its explicitly authorized Evidence text are exposed to the mutation runner.
Complete before/after pagination and existing item, field, archive, repository and view configuration readbacks remain in place.
No importer, workflow, merge, branch deletion, release or deployment operation is added.

result: No unresolved material finding in the bounded HTTP-guard and publication-helper closure reviews. Actual exact-WAR runtime and remote publication readbacks remain separate evidence.
scope: Closure review of configured HTTP response-header secret scanning, redirect detection, and per-response stateless cookie policy. No implementation changes made by this review.
